api_key_private.description: Private API key for Mailjet. Default to the value of the `MJ_APIKEY_PRIVATE` environment variable.

api_key_public.description: Public API key for Mailjet. Default to the value of the `MJ_APIKEY_PUBLIC` environment variable.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Mailjet API. Default to https://api.mailjet.com/v3.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this sender object was created.

dns_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the DNS domain to which sender belongs.

email.description: The email address for this sender. To register a domain use *@example.com.

email_type.description: Type of emails this sender will send. This is for purely informative purposes - the values do not place any sending restrictions on the sender email or domain. Can be transactional, bulk or unknown

id.description: Unique numeric ID of this sender.

is_default_sender.description: Indicates whether this is the default sender or not.

id.description: Unique numeric ID for the sender you want to validate.

wait_for.description: When specified, the provider will make multiple attempts to validate the resource until the specified duration is reached. One attempt is made per second.

dns_id.description: Unique numeric ID of the domain settings

dkim_record_name.description: Name of the DNS DKIM record to insert for this domain.

dkim_record_value.description: Value to insert in the DNS DKIM record for this domain.

domain.description: The name of the domain linked to this DNS record.

ownership_token.description: Value of the token to verify the ownership of the domain.

ownership_token_record_name.description: Value to use when configuring the TXT record (DNS) verification for the domain.

spf_record_value.description: Value to insert in the DNS SPF record for this domain.
